documents.title: Responsible Use of Artificial Intelligence
documents.stance_why: The page says 'students must adhere to the expectations outlined by their instructors' and 'many faculty may encourage or even require the use of AI, others may prohibit it', so it sets no single rule and hands the decision to instructors.
documents.summary: Student-facing academic-integrity statement. Students must follow each instructor's AI rules, attribute and understand AI content, and respect copyright; unauthorized AI-generated work may violate the conduct code.

units.why: The opening sentence sets the purpose of the page: NJIT 'values academic integrity and ethical behavior in all learning activities, including using artificial intelligence (AI) tools'.
